verses.1: To be destroyed by their own hands, so that they may gather together in one place.
verses.2: My voice cries out to God; I shout to God, and He hears me.
verses.3: On the day of my distress, I pleaded with Adonai. I asked for help in the night, but He did not respond. My soul was filled with sorrow.
verses.4: God remembered me, and I will be saved. My soul will be taken up into heaven.
verses.5: You have taken hold of my eyes; they are closed, and I cannot speak.
verses.6: I thought that many days have passed since those ancient times.
verses.7: I remembered the melody I sang that night with my heart. My soul searched for it.
verses.8: The nations will abandon their gods, and they will no longer desire them.
verses.9: May His kindness last forever. Endure, O Lord, from generation to generation.
verses.10: He forgot his promises. If he had clung to His mercy, then everything would have been different.
verses.11: And he said, “My wound is on my right side.”
verses.12: I remember the evil deeds of those who have done evil; for I remember them from before.
verses.13: And I will praise all your deeds and your victories.
verses.14: God is holy; your ways are pure. No one else is as great as God.
verses.15: You are the God who creates all things in your nations.
verses.16: You have redeemed your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph.
verses.17: May God see you from the depths of the sea. May the waves cover you, and may the mountains be destroyed.
verses.18: They poured thick waters; they gave loud voices. Your faces were covered with tears.
verses.19: Your thunderous voice echoed throughout the heavens. The sky was filled with lightning; the earth trembled and shook.
verses.20: Your path through the sea, and your resting place in those vast waters… We do not know where you go.
verses.21: I have brought your people down like lambs into Moses’ hands and Aaron’s hands.
